notes.title: Patch 1.6 - Knockout
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

Gameplay:
-Players can now knockout Guards when close enough behind them, and they are not otherwise stunned or playing an investigation animation.

This feature isn't perfect and can be temperamental, but there have been requests for this ability since release so here it finally is.

-Extended all Guard Stun durations from Charged and Un-Charged Pistol shots.
-Extended Security Camera and Light Disabled durations.
-All maps have had their Encounter Zones, the areas in which Security Cameras and Guards "request" reinforcements, adjusted. This significantly reduces the issue of getting ganged up by half the map's Guards when alerting one.
-Added a new Flashbang Stun animation.
-New Tutorial prompt for Knockouts.

Cheers all!
-Knight Division Games

notes.title: Patch 1.5 - Quick Fix
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed an issue causing the Player to not be able to interact with the Tank Objectives on the final mission, Desert Rat.
-Fixed issues with some Security Cameras not properly alerting nearby guards.

Gameplay:
-Added an additional Security Camera to the Desert Rat mission.

Cheers all!
-Knight Division Games

notes.title: Patch 1.4 - I Hear You
notes.notes:
Gameplay and AI improvements, bug fixes while interacting with Computer Terminals.

Patch Notes

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed the Player from being able to interrupt the hack animation on Computer Terminals by jumping
-Fixed the Player from being able to aim their weapon or grenades while interacting with Computer Terminals, which caused camera rotation issues

Gameplay:
-Player can now interact with doors and most other objects while aiming
-Improved AI tracking of Report Noise Events, while investigating a location the AI will now move to the most recent sound they have heard instead of the first

Cheers all!
-Knight Division Games

notes.title: Patch 1.3 - Doorway to Better Gameplay
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

While the past two patches were primarily focused on improving stability, tweaking levels, and fixing issues, this patch is more focused on improving the moment to moment gameplay.

Patch Notes

Gameplay:
-Doors are now bi-directional and swing both ways
-Guards stopping for Patrols and Investigations are now clamped at a max of 10 seconds to be more consistent and not remain in one spot for long durations
-Radios can now be activated and de-activated at a distance with Un-Charged Pistol shots, Charged shots  do....well you'll have to find out ;)
-Reduced time to Charge Pistol shots
-Slightly reduced area of effect radius of EMP grenades
-Increased the Report Noise Event range of Noisemaker grenades and Player Whistle
-Reduced the fuse timers for all grenades
-Added more Text entries to Guard AI Reactions and Investigation Statuses
-New HUD Toggle On/Off option by pressing 'H', Interact icons will still display
-Increased Stun duration of both Un-Charged and Charged Pistol shots on Guards
-Fire Extinguishers shot with Charged Pistol shots now create a larger plume of smoke to hide behind that covers a wider area, but dissipates quicker

Cheers all!
-Knight Division Games

notes.title: Patch 1.2 - Light Up The Night
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, hope you've been enjoying the game despite any issues. This patch aims to fix and improve a few important items.

Patch Notes

Bug Fixes:
-More checks are made when climbing / mantling to prevent getting stuck in walls
-Fixed a glitch causing the player to become unable to climb / mantle objects
-Desert Rat mission optimizations, overall level file size reduced by nearly 1GB
-Fixed a Computer Terminal in the loading dock area of Black Gold that could be hacked from outside the building

Gameplay:
-Reduced crouch movement report noise events, making standard crouch walking more quiet on most surfaces
-Improved climbing / mantling, it should be much more consistent now
-Volumetric Lights have replaced the previous Vision Cones Meshes, these lights provide more realistic lighting cones which properly get blocked by the environment
-Security Camera's color change when detecting the player is more noticeable 
-Frozen Snake mission - Reduced fog density for better clarity
-Deep Descent mission - Level Improvements with more cover and larger hallways, as well as extending the starting spawn area
-Black Gold mission - Slight changes to a few AI patrol paths, moved one of the Readable items and minor changes to Mission Briefing to provide more clarity on where the player needs to go to extract the mission

Cheers all!
-Knight Division Games

notes.title: Launch Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Launch Patch!
Thank you everyone for your support, feedback, and bug reports. Please keep them coming and post any issues you have in the Discord, and if you enjoy the game consider leaving a Steam review.

Patch Notes

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed the camera freezing in place when hacking an Objective Terminal while using a controller
(Note: It will still pause rotation while hacking, but will resume after completion)
-Fixed Extraction Points not working even if all Objectives were completed
-Slightly adjusted the Climb Height to give better results when trying to vault up small objects
-(Hopefully) Fixed Tutorial Tips from being stuck on the screen

Gameplay:
-Expanded and adjusted the opening Tutorial Level with a new area, particularly the location where the player first encounters Guards, removed one of the Guards and added more Tutorial Tips throughout
-Fixed some Surveillance Cameras not properly alerting nearby Guards to the player when detected
-Adjusted the Audio Levels Noise Event of doors being kicked/slammed
-Enlarged the Door Interaction Collision Box allowing them to be opened and closed from further away, and to help in instances in which a player may get stuck while using them (More tweaks and changes are planned for doors for a future Patch)

Cheers all!
-Knight Division Games

notes.title: New Release Date - March 30th
notes.notes:
Hey, gang!

I'm announcing a brief, one week delay from the original release date of the 23rd, to the 30th.

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42236772/a45200106b5f8886b80f948e104f935f3b7e49db.png

This is to help give a little extra time to iron out a few remaining issues that have cropped up in live builds that weren't appearing in the UE editor, set up the specific file formatting Steam needs, tidy up the Steam page, and put together a proper launch trailer.

The past two weeks have seen a lot of nice quality of life changes and bug fixes to the game. The levels are all completed and furnished with minor tweaks to improve flow here and there, and after extensive playtesting this past week there have been no hard crashes for myself or any testers. Bugs are being squashed and the gameplay is getting more refined.

Thank you all for your understanding, and if all goes well the next update will be the Launch Trailer and Release Announcement!

Cloak & Dagger: Shadow Operations will be releasing on March 23, 2023 for $4.99 USD!

Cloak & Dagger: Shadow Operations is a short, single player, third person, tactical stealth action game set in the early 1990's meant to be finished in one sitting. Use the shadows, shoot out lights, stun enemies, and conceal yourself in the darkness through 5 Missions.
